name: Card number copier for woocommerce
author: WP irani

sections.description:
The Card number copier for woocommerce plugin is an independent plugin built at the request of WordPress users.
If the direct bank transfer option is enabled, the Card number copier for woocommerce plugin adds a button to the Account number and Sort code number for a better and more attractive user interface.This plugin helps to display a copy button to the user when the bank transfer option is enabled in the WooCommerce payment gateways section so that they can easily copy the card number, account number, IBank, etc.

Current plugin features

  • Add copy button for account number (Enable/Disable)
  • Add copy button for sort code (Enable/Disable)
  • change text of buttons
  • change alert messages when numbers copied

For more information, visit:
Here’s a link to the Persian Information Page.
sections.installation:
Minimum Requirements

  • WordPress 5.1 or greater
  • PHP version 7.2 or greater
  • MySQL version 5.0 or greater
  • WC tested up to: 9.5.1

Installation

  1. Install using the WordPress built-in Plugin installer, or Extract the zip file and drop the contents in the wp-content/plugins/ directory of your WordPress installation.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Woocommerce > Copy Buttons > change any options > save settings
  4. You can now view the changes made to the thank you page by enable bank transfer option then add product to card and going to buy with bank transfer payment gateway
sections.faq:
How to configure the plugin?

  • Plugin settings are simple and easy to do. Just go to “Copy Buttons” menu under Woocommerce section from the WordPress dashboard, and after changing the available options, click Save Settings.

Are your plugin features limited?

  • No, some parts are limited, but more features and options will be added in future versions of the plugin.

Is this decrease speed of my site?

  • No, this plugin is coded lightly and the relevant codes are only executed on the WooCommerce “Thank You” page.
